feed.rejection_location: Table 3, 0.2 micrometre membrane, transient below Jcrit, 1.6 m/s, pH 7.5, 0.1 bar
feed.critical_flux_conditions: Effluent of synthetic activated sludge production; 0.2 micrometre membrane, pH 7.5, 20-25 degC; reported lowest measured laminar operating point
feed.scope: The source critical-flux point is retained as context and is not transferred to the new geometry and low Reynolds number. Retention measured at 1.6 m/s is transferred as an illustrative constant with 0.5-0.8 sensitivity; not validated at our speed. COD is an external lumped tracer, not a chemical species or a DWSIM property model.

scope: Verified low-Re fully developed, nonpermeating, straight star-channel hydraulics; axial periodicity represents a developed segment, not entrance losses. Julia supplies a slowly varying distributed permeating-channel model and conservative external COD retention. DWSIM is a water-carrier hydraulic port representation. Reported COD rejection is a transferred sensitivity, not validated at the new speed. Critical flux and sustainable operating time are unavailable at the new geometry/Re; no critical-flux admissibility is claimed. No fitted fouling time, turbulence, osmotic or reactive model.
